Record Date Shareholders received one Right for each outstanding whole common share held on the record date. The Rights entitle their holders to purchase one new common share for every five Rights held; however, any Record Date Shareholder who owns fewer than five common shares as of the close of business on the Record Date will be entitled to subscribe for one common share. The subscription price per common share was $13.30.

events.fact: Form 4 reports 2,564 shares, code F, on 2026-10-28. Reported price $13.66 per share.
footnotes: On October 28, 2026, the Reporting Person exercised the incentive stock option granted 10/14/2021 under the Company's 2017 Stock Option Plan (the "2017 Plan") for the purchase of 5,000 shares of the Company's Common Stock at an exercise price of $7.005 per share (the "Option shares"). As permitted by the 2017 Plan, the Reporting Person elected to pay the exercise price of the Option Shares by having the Company withhold from the Option Shares a number of shares having a fair market value equal to the aggregate exercise price of $35,025. Since the fair market value of the Company's Common Stock on October 28, 2026, (as determined in accordance with the 2017 Plan) was $13.66 per share, the Company withheld 2,564 shares of Common Stock ($35,025 divided by $13.66) to pay the aggregate exercise price of the option.
